title: Filtered-scan LIMIT pushdown + aggregate LIMIT truncation fix

tasks.title: Push LIMIT into filtered, unordered, non-aggregate single-table scans so the full scan early-breaks after offset+limit matches
Guard the pushdown against aggregates, window functions, and DISTINCT (which must observe the full row set)
Fix pre-existing bug: outer LIMIT/OFFSET truncated scanned rows before COUNT(*)/bare-aggregate computation
Add focused tests (filtered LIMIT count, OFFSET, DISTINCT guard, bare-aggregate not truncated) and update ROADMAP
